MEMORANDUM TO THE BOARD OF [AUTHORITY]

Re: Taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Counsel's caution first: I have not accepted any round figure below without rebuilding it.

Financing. To net $12,000,000 after a 2.0% issuance cost paid from proceeds, par must be at least $12,244,898; rounded up to the next $5,000, par is $12,245,000 (net $12,000,100). At 4.50% fixed, months 1-24 are interest-only at $45,918.75 per month. Months 25-240 amortize at a level $82,815.95 per month. Total interest over the term is about $6,745,295. Against projected NOI of $1,500,000, amortization-period coverage is about 1.509x, a thin cushion for a single-credit taxable bond.

PILOT. Year-1 full combined tax is $291,276 (equipment valued at $8,100,000 in year 1). Equipment is $6,300,000 in year 3 and reaches its 20% floor in year 8, when full tax is $225,720. Year-6 PILOT, after a 50% abatement, is $123,120. Abated tax over years 1-10 totals $1,447,740, or about $9,652 per job for 150 jobs; its present value at 5.0% is about $1,210,577.

Recommendation: approve subject to confirming the figures with the financial advisor.
